svg.aria-label: Isla Paradiso: sim step time, Baseline vs v0.3.1
svg.text: Isla Paradiso: sim step time over a 10-minute run, Baseline vs v0.3.1
Each mark: the slowest sim step in a 0.7 s slice; steps under 50 ms are not recorded. Dashed line: 300 ms, a stutter you notice.
Minute 0-1 (loading) and harness-caused steps are left out, as in the README table. Same save, same machine.
Baseline (our mods off), run off-2: 39.0 sim steps/s, 188 steps of 300 ms or longer, worst 795 ms
v0.3.1 (our mods on), run on-2: 45.9 sim steps/s, 15 steps of 300 ms or longer, worst 528 ms
